title: MAA website navigation
answer: The main navigation includes Home, Food, Medicine, Travel, Talk to MAA, Login and Get Started. Food leads to Home Made Food, Medicine leads to Medicine and Health, and Travel leads to Plan Trip, Travel Tips and Emergency.

title: The MAA home page
answer: The home page introduces the MAA platform and provides navigation to its main services. It also contains user testimonials under the Loved by Many section.

title: Services listed in the website footer
answer: The Services section of the MAA footer lists Home Made Food, Medicine and Health, Travel Assistance, and AI Companion.

title: Company section in the website footer
answer: The Company section of the MAA footer includes About Us, Contact, Privacy Policy, and Terms of Service links.
